items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: Baby and Johnny lived just across the street from us, where my mother lived.

ctx.x: Um, keyhole, I think they used to call it, keyhole. Yeah. But anyway, uh, now one, when, when we lived in New Orleans, on Cleveland, they changed the name to Gasket Street. Mm-hmm. Baby and Johnny lived just across the street from us, where my mother lived. You lived on Gasket? Yeah.

Mm-hmm. Gasket and what? Um, right close to Rowan. Mm-hmm. About four blocks from Allen and Guidry's, Guidry and Allen's, do you remember that place? Minetta used to talk about that place to me. No. It's, it's...
